description: Validates catastrophe bond trigger term structure and computes layer arithmetic: attachment/exhaustion point ordering, pro-rata layer penetration factor, payout amount, and layer position (BELOW_ATTACHMENT / WITHIN_LAYER / ABOVE_EXHAUSTION). Cat bonds outstanding $63.9B Q1 2026 (record $25.6B issuance 2025). Validates ISDA/IAIS trigger term constraints including attachment > 0 and exhaustion > attachment. Use in parametric-trigger-adjudication chain downstream of trigger evaluation, or standalone in cat-bond-trigger-validation chain. ZERO PII.

output.not_legal_advice: Not legal or actuarial advice. Final payout determination requires review of the controlling bond indenture and independent loss verification.
output.pii_note: ZERO PII: layer terms and aggregate loss amounts only. No policyholder, claimant, or event-specific personal data enters this kernel.
output.regulatory_basis: ISDA/IAIS cat bond trigger definitions; Swiss Re sigma cat bond trigger methodology (indemnity / industry loss index / parametric / modelled loss). Layer arithmetic per standard IAIS ICP 13 reinsurance principles.
output.table_source: ISDA/IAIS cat bond trigger definitions; Swiss Re sigma 1/2024; ARTEMIS.bm cat bond market data Q1 2026; NAIC catastrophe bond guidelines
